description: Intent i010 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=xsk-umem-rings) complete. Finding (low confidence, reported): include/net/xdp_sock_drv.h:284-309, xsk_tx_metadata_request(). The 'meta' pointer comes from __xsk_buff_get_metadata() (data - pool->tx_metadata_len) into the user-mapped AF_XDP UMEM TX-metadata area; xsk_buff_valid_tx_metadata() (lines 262-272) READ_ONCE-caches only meta->flags and validates flags + tx_metadata_len, but xsk_tx_metadata_request() then re-dereferences the shared struct: meta->flags at lines 294/299/303/307 (discarding the validated snapshot in *flags, which is never passed in) and meta->request.csum_start/csum_offset at 304-305 and meta->request.launch_time at 295, with no READ_ONCE and no local cache — the seed's validated-equals-used invariant broken on the same struct xsk_tx_metadata, reached from every zero-copy TX path (mlx5 en/xsk/tx.c:102→en/xdp.c:508/656, igc igc_main.c:3077/3085, stmmac stmmac_main.c:2722/2751, libeth/idpf include/net/libeth/xsk.h:208). Exact source evidence: lines 302-305 'if (ops->tmo_request_checksum) / if (meta->flags & XDP_TXMD_FLAGS_CHECKSUM) / ops->tmo_request_checksum(meta->request.csum_start, / meta->request.csum_offset, priv);' (verified literal in the snapshot). Impact is unproven: mlx5e and libeth .tmo_request_checksum implementations ignore both values (flag-only), igc/stmmac register no checksum op, and launch_time is consumed only as a time u64, so no current in-tree consumer turns the second fetch into an OOB access — confidence low, expressed in the artifact. Also classified: 7 safe candidates (seed-fixed xsk_skb_metadata at net/xdp/xsk.c:964 with READ_ONCE locals; xskq_cons_read_desc/batch struct-copy-by-value snapshots at net/xdp/xsk_queue.h:249/277; __xp_alloc fill-ring local addr at net/xdp/xsk_buff_pool.c:561; __xsk_buff_get_metadata pointer validation; completion path xsk_tx_metadata_to_compl) and 3 unresolved (igc launch_time at igc_main.c:3077, stmmac launch_time at stmmac_main.c:2751, mlx5 metadata flow through indirect calls at en/xsk/tx.c:102). Bounded negative evidence: ring descriptor reads are all single-fetch struct copies into kernel-local arrays; no other net/xdp consumer re-reads validated UMEM/ring memory. Limitations: igc_tx_launchtime/igc_insert_empty_frame and stmmac_set_desc_tbs internals not fully audited for derived index math; search bounded to the xsk/AF_XDP branch and its four driver consumers; no runtime reproducer built.
